verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents per-sync run outcome reporting, a sync-run debugger for rejected rows, and sync failure alerts. Each sync maps one model to one destination, so failures can be diagnosed per destination, and a vendor-sourced community comment mentions a live debugger and alerting. Missing for 10: any documented live view of events flowing through Hightouch Events, delivery metrics or dashboards (volumes, latency, success rates per destination), detailed docs on alert channels and conditions, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.
